title: Holiday Crashers
description: During the holiday season, Toni and Bri decide to shake up their mundane world by creating new identities to crash the Christmas parties from the shop's confidential invitations.

title: A Dance in the Snow
description: Melanie's autistic daughter, Jenny, plans a party with friends while Melanie works with Jenny's teacher to create an inclusive school dance, leading to romantic sparks.

title: Single On The 25th
description: The story follows a 30-something who spends Christmas alone in the city, only to find unexpected companionship with a handsome neighbour.

title: Three Wisest Men
description: The Brenner brothers are back and putting on a holiday pageant for young Thomas, while trying to cope with life's curveballs, including their mum's new boyfriend.

title: Believe In Christmas
description: When Beatrice reluctantly joins her best friend on a trip to the enchanting Christmasland, she remains sceptical. But festive traditions and a friendly stranger warms her heart.

title: This Time Each Year
description: A year after their separation, Lauren and Kevin focus on raising their young son, Charlie, together. However, Kevin harbours a desire to make them a whole family again.

title: The Christmas Quest
description: When an archaeologist begins a search for an ancient Christmas treasure, she must team up with her ex-husband - who is an expert in Nordic languages - to find it.

title: Holiday Touchdown: A Chief's...
description: Chiefs superfan Alana tries to win the Fan of the Year Award as a Christmas gift for her family, falling in love with someone from the Chiefs' front office along the way.

title: A Cowboy Christmas
description: A young executive is sent to a ranch in Canada to pitch to a high-profile CEO there on holiday. She arrives ready for business, but not for the ranch's rustic charm.

title: A Make Or Break Holiday
description: A couple hosting Christmas decides to fake their relationship after choosing to separate. Working together for the holiday helps them remember why they fell in love.

title: All I Need For Christmas
description: Looking for inspiration, singer songwriter Maggie travels home and finds a spark with app developer Archer, who's trying to repair his relationship with his sister.

title: Santa Tell Me
description: When Olivia finds a letter from Santa promising she'll meet the love of her life by Christmas Eve - and that his name will be Nick - she's stunned by three potential suitors.

title: Christmas Under The Lights
description: Emily reluctantly returns home to her family's rescue ranch to organise the Christmas Carnival to honour her mother, meeting a handsome artist along the way.

title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bills Love Story
description: Sparks fly between two lifelong Buffalo Bills fans as they try to discover the identity of a mysterious Christmas gift-giver.

title: A Grand Ole Opry Christmas
description: Gentry, who gave up music after her father's death, must confront her past when the Grand Ole Opry invites her to honour her late country star dad at their Christmas celebration.

title: Season's Greetings From...
description: Across three different eras, different families occupy a family home, leaving their own festive mark throughout the years despite life's challenges.

title: Happy Holidays From Cherry Lane
description: In three intertwined timelines, different generations of one family navigate holiday challenges, from caring for an aging father to planning a Christmas Eve wedding.

title: Catch Me If You Claus
description: On the verge of her big break, an aspiring news anchor catches a home intruder wearing a red suit - claiming to be the son of Santa Claus.

title: Time For Him To Come...
description: Elizabeth receives a voicemail that wasn't meant for her four days before Christmas. Can she get this man's heartfelt message to the love of his life in time.
